Siemens

Simcenter Nastran

Simcenter Nastran provides finite-element solutions for structural, dynamics and thermal problems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a solver-ready model

Use the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended Simcenter Nastran preview, build a solver-ready model; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Execute a selected solution

Start from the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended Simcenter Nastran preview, execute a selected solution; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review structural response

Begin with the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended Simcenter Nastran preview, review structural response; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
